svg.title: E-Commerce Customer Segmentation Engine — project flow
svg.desc: Six-phase project flow: transaction data, preprocessing, RFM scoring (Recency, Frequency, Monetary), K-Means clustering, Customer Lifetime Value, marketing dashboard

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What dataset should I use for the E-Commerce Customer Segmentation project? Suggest options including Indian e-commerce datasets.')
sendPrompt('Walk me through all the data preprocessing steps for the Customer Segmentation project in Python, with code examples using pandas.')
sendPrompt('Show me Python pandas code to calculate the Recency score for RFM analysis.')
sendPrompt('Show me Python pandas code to calculate the Frequency score for RFM analysis.')
sendPrompt('Show me Python pandas code to calculate the Monetary score for RFM analysis.')
sendPrompt('Show me how to implement K-Means clustering for customer segmentation in Python using scikit-learn, including the elbow method and silhouette score.')
sendPrompt('Show me how to calculate Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) in Python using the BG/NBD model and the lifetimes library.')
sendPrompt('How do I build a Marketing Insights Dashboard using Plotly Dash in Python for the customer segmentation project, showing segment distributions and campaign insights?')
